_finding.question: Is the quarter to 31-03-2026 a cliff or a trough?
_finding.answer: NEITHER, IN THE TERMS THE QUESTION WAS ASKED. The question assumed one collapse; there are two different things happening and they have to be separated.
_finding.revenue_is_a_plateau_not_a_cliff: The comparison this study has been making is Q1-2026's 2,094 against Q1-2025's 3,723, a fall of 43.8%. But Q1-2025 is the PEAK of the five quarters, and revenue reached its current level three quarters ago: 2,161 (Q3-25), 2,219 (Q4-25), 2,094 (Q1-26). Against the immediately preceding quarter the fall is 5.6%. Revenue has been flat around 2,100-2,200 for three quarters and the steep part of the decline happened in the middle of 2025, not in the latest quarter.
_finding.the_margin_is_the_event: Gross margin ran 33.1%, 24.9%, 32.6%, 29.0% and then 5.7%. It is a ONE-QUARTER shock with no precedent in the series, and it is not a volume effect: cost of revenues ROSE to 1,975 in Q1-2026 from 1,577 in Q4-2025 while revenue FELL. Something repriced the input cost or the mix, and the four preceding quarters average 30.1%.
_finding.what_this_bears_on: The study forecasts a 4.1% FY2026E EBITDA margin, struck off this one quarter. That annualises the worst quarter in the record against a four-quarter mean of 30.1% on the gross line. Whether that is right is now a QUESTION WITH TWO SIDES that can be priced, which it was not before this record existed -- and pricing both sides is what the contested-judgement register is for. NOTHING HERE MOVES THE FAIR VALUE TOWARD THE PRICE OR AWAY FROM IT; it makes a judgement that was invisible into one that can be published both ways.
_finding.the_thing_neither_side_changes: Interest expense is 514-596 per quarter and barely moves: about 2,250 a year against FY2025 EBITDA of 2,866. Roughly four fifths of operating cash earnings goes to lenders before anything reaches equity, and in Q1-2026 EBITDA of 15.5 met interest of 575.7. That is the structural fact under this name and it is independent of which margin the forecast adopts.
_finding.not_yet_done: The study has NOT been rebuilt on this. Recording the record and the finding is this pass; the rebuild, and pricing the margin judgement both ways, is the next one.
